name: Marnie's Moment
source: You've come to beautiful Lumiose City, the crown jewel of Kalos. There are things to see, people to meet, and a cute girl with a funny accent and a mischievous pokémon. Maybe you can make friends with her? Maybe a new friend is what she really needs right now? Maybe things will escalate from there? Or maybe you're just killing time in Kalos.
translation: 你来到了美丽的卢米奥塞城，卡洛斯皇冠上的明珠。有可看的东西，可认识的人，还有一个口音滑稽的可爱女孩和一只调皮的神奇宝贝。也许你可以和她交朋友？也许她现在真正需要的是一个新朋友？也许事情会从那里升级？或者也许你只是在卡洛斯消磨时间。
